stop_reason: Sumida medium and Akihabara medium each required one closed-mouth correction. Ueno medium turned toward the window then returned forward, failing its required watching ending. The app rejected an attempted resting-state acceptance. No bypass or third extra request followed; all takes were preserved and the run was paused.

account_audit.note: Nine matching 100-credit transactions confirm the trial debit. Initial-to-final balance delta differs by 50; the account page displays an additional 50 daily credits. No refund assumed.

monthly_capacity.qualification: At the observed 100-credit Quality price, 30 new 12-shot videos per 30 days exceed the displayed included allowance before retries or other use. This is allowance arithmetic, not a measured production-throughput result.

visual_findings.accepted: Distinct Sumida water/bridge/Skytree, Yanaka rooftops and Akihabara shopping streets. Deliberate camera/district cuts work without endpoint matching. Character, closed coat, gills, cup, hands and tabletop objects remain usable in the accepted draft shots.
limits: Several rest takes keep the eyes closed instead of performing the requested brief blink; calm-rest interpretation recorded, final aesthetic review pending.
Yanaka medium needed source frames 12–192 to end after eyelid closure; other accepted shots use 0–180.
Generated Akihabara signage and illustrated advertising need review or replacement before commercial release.
Ueno motion has a failed ending action and is excluded. Ueno wide, Shinjuku and Tokyo Bay motion were not generated.
Tokyo Bay stills have a level horizon, bridge and water behind the fixed window; the closing panorama has not been motion-qualified.

partial_delivery.scope: Silent 45-second review sample; not a completed 90-second video or release approval

workflow_findings: Independent shots remove generated endpoint matching but do not remove per-take character/action errors.
Thirteen image preparations and nine native video downloads/imports still required assisted handoffs and visual review.
Two mouth retries succeeded; a further action error exhausted the deliberately small extra-attempt allowance before completing the plan.
UI preview caching was corrected in U06a; stopped-run partial export was added in U06b.

Active human operator time was not instrumented. Request-to-result-observation intervals include other work, polling and UI handoffs. Browser automation stalls, overnight waits and app repairs are not representative human production time.
Do not qualify unattended production, lower overall effort, or 30 videos per month from this run.
next_recommended_trial: Keep independent cuts and the prepared references. Before another full run, test a short ambient-motion brief with a fixed character pose, including the Tokyo Bay closing view. Recheck model/cost allowances and keep a small explicit retry cap; no new request is authorized or submitted by this recommendation.
